description: Personal finance management application to track income, expenses, budgets, and credit card transactions

core: Income and expense tracking by category

views.name: Flow Grid
views.description: Main financial flow view showing income/expenses in a grid format with multiple time periods (weeks/months)
features: Customizable number of periods to display

views.name: Dashboard
views.description: Overview of financial health with charts and summaries
features: Execution vs. pending vs. remaining breakdown
Category expense chart with historical data
Category breakdown with credit card indicator

views.name: Credit Cards
features: Item categorization (purchase, recurring, payment, fee, tax)
OCR scanning for credit card statements

components.TransactionDetail: View and edit transaction details in modal
components.BulkOperationsModal: Perform bulk updates on multiple transactions
components.CategoryExpenseChart: Interactive chart with hover effects for category expenses
components.EmailImportModal: Import transactions from bank email notifications
components.OCRScanner: Scan and extract data from images/documents
components.ThemeToggle: Switch between light and dark mode
components.ProjectionGrid: Display and manage credit card projections

dataModels.Budget: Budget allocations by category and period
dataModels.CreditCardItem: Individual charges on credit card statements

keyUserFlows: Add a new income/expense transaction via inline editing in FlowGrid
View transaction details and update status (paid/pending/cancelled)
Navigate between months to view historical data
Expand categories to see transaction breakdown
Manage credit card statements and categorize expenses
Project future credit card expenses with installments
Import transactions from bank email notifications
Toggle between light and dark themes

apiEndpoints.description: Fetch flow grid data with income/expense by category and period
Fetch dashboard summary with charts and category breakdown
Fetch credit card data and projections

testingPriorities: Transaction creation and editing in FlowGrid
Dashboard chart rendering and data accuracy
